cwe_id: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function
detection_method: Active Nmap NSE script ('modbus-discover') & Wireshark protocol capture
evidence: Nmap NSE script 'modbus-discover' confirmed unauthenticated read/write access. Successfully executed Modbus Function 06 (Preset Single Register) to modify register 40001 (Valve Demand Setpoint) without authentication challenge.
operational_consequences: Adversary can remotely override steam valve demand (P1_PCV01D), driving column pressure to 2.85 kPa. Leads to boiler tube thermal stress, loss of separation equilibrium, and emergency shutdown ($50,000/hr downtime).
recommended_remediation: 1. Deploy an OT industrial firewall enforcing Modbus Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) to block unauthorized Function 05/06 write commands from non-engineering hosts. 2. Implement ISA/IEC 62443 zone and conduit segmentation restricting Modbus traffic strictly to authorized SCADA Master (192.168.10.5).
verification_procedure: Inject Modbus Function 06 packet from rogue host 192.168.10.99 toward 192.168.10.11:502. Verify packet is dropped by perimeter firewall rule and controller register remains unmodified.
re_test_notes: Retest confirmed: OT Firewall rule drops all Modbus write packets originating outside engineering subnet 192.168.10.0/24.

vulnerability_title: Weak Credential and Unencrypted Remote Management
evidence: Service enumeration revealed open VNC service accepting default password 'operator123'. Cleartext VNC traffic intercepted with Wireshark, capturing operator graphic displays and live alarm screens.
likelihood_score: HIGH (Easily guessable password on standard port)
impact_score: HIGH (Full remote graphical operator console access)
operational_consequences: Adversary gains full graphic control of operator displays, allowing unauthorized setpoint modifications, alarm silencing, and masking of critical process trips.
recommended_remediation: 1. Decommission legacy unencrypted VNC service on Port 5900. 2. Enforce TLS-encrypted RDP with multi-factor authentication (MFA) from authorized jump host bastion only.
verification_procedure: Attempt TCP SYN connection to port 5900 on 192.168.10.5. Verify port is filtered/closed and operator sessions require MFA jump host.
re_test_notes: Retest confirmed: Port 5900 closed. Secure Bastion gateway deployed.

vulnerability_title: Missing Patch on Workstation OS (Potential Stuxnet-Style Lateral Ingress)
cwe_id: CWE-264: Permissions, Privileges, and Access Controls
detection_method: Vulnerability assessment scan & Active Directory GPO audit
evidence: Vulnerability scan identified outdated SMB signing configuration and unmanaged removable media execution policies on engineering workstation.
likelihood_score: MEDIUM (Requires physical USB insertion or local lateral movement)
impact_score: CRITICAL (Workstation has direct PLC ladder logic download privileges)
operational_consequences: Stuxnet-style malware infection via USB stick allows adversary to inject malicious ladder logic blocks into Siemens/Schneider PLCs, modifying turbine governor speeds (P4_ST_GOV).
recommended_remediation: 1. Disable USB Mass Storage device execution via Windows Group Policy Object (GPO). 2. Mandate SMB packet signing and isolate engineering workstation on dedicated maintenance VLAN.
verification_procedure: Insert test USB mass storage device into EWS-01; verify Windows policy actively blocks file execution. Verify SMB signing enforced via PowerShell.
re_test_notes: GPO deployed to staging OU; final verification scheduled.

vulnerability_title: Default Public SNMP Community String in Offsites Controller
cwe_id: CWE-1188: Insecure Default Initialization of Resource
detection_method: SNMP-walk probe with standard dictionary wordlist
evidence: SNMPv2c query with community 'public' returned system description, network interfaces, and tank manifold PLC hardware details.
operational_consequences: Adversary obtains tank farm controller firmware revision, routing tables, and interface statistics, enabling targeted exploit planning.
recommended_remediation: 1. Upgrade to SNMPv3 with SHA authentication and AES encryption. 2. Disable default community strings 'public' and 'private'.
verification_procedure: Execute snmpwalk -v2c -c public 192.168.10.12; verify request times out or is rejected.
